name: Exaverse
storyline:
The Exadons come from a parallel Earth where the dinosaurs never went extinct. Over millions of years they evolved into a sentient civilization, building their world around powerful GEMS buried deep beneath the planet.

Then the machines arrived.

Drawn to the immense energy within the GEMS, they invaded without warning and began harvesting the planet itself. Cities fell, ecosystems collapsed, and the Exadons were pushed to the edge of extinction.

In desperation, they opened a portal to our Earth.Now you enter the Exaverse through that portal, fighting through machine territory, recovering lost relics, and uncovering what the machines are really searching for beneath the surface.
summary: Extinction of the Exaverse is a mobile roguelike where evolved dinosaurs fight back against invading AI machines. Players progress through biome-based runs, choosing powerful upgrades and building unique combat styles each attempt.
